transcript.speaker: Maya
transcript.text: Welcome to Media Mix, the show about where ad dollars are going next. I'm Maya Brooks, and today I'm joined by connected-TV buyer Tom Albright.

transcript.speaker: Tom
transcript.text: Thanks Maya. Great timing, too. This has been the busiest upfront season I've seen in fifteen years.

transcript.speaker: Maya
transcript.text: Let's set the stage. When did the big streamers finally give in to advertising?

transcript.speaker: Tom
transcript.text: Netflix was the big domino. It launched its Basic with Ads plan in November 2022, and after that everyone else felt they had permission.

transcript.speaker: Tom
transcript.text: Right. Prime Video turned ads on by default in January 2024, and members have to pay an extra $2.99 a month if they want them gone.

transcript.speaker: Maya
transcript.text: How big is the Netflix ad tier audience at this point?

transcript.speaker: Tom
transcript.text: Still pretty small. It's about 5 million monthly active users globally, which is why a lot of buyers still treat it as a test budget.

transcript.speaker: Maya
transcript.text: What does the creative actually look like on connected TV?

transcript.speaker: Tom
transcript.text: Honestly, most brands are still just running their linear spots. That's a wasted opportunity when the screen is interactive.

transcript.speaker: Maya
transcript.text: Do you have proof that it works better than linear?

transcript.speaker: Tom
transcript.text: One of our CPG clients ran a CTV-only flight last quarter and saw a 30% lift in brand recall compared with their linear buy.

transcript.speaker: Maya
transcript.text: And measurement? That always comes up with our clients.

transcript.speaker: Tom
transcript.text: Measurement is still the wild west. Every platform grades its own homework, and buyers should push for independent verification.

transcript.speaker: Maya
transcript.text: Where does all of this end up?

transcript.speaker: Tom
transcript.text: Within five years, linear TV will be under 10% of total US video ad spend. I'm confident about that.

transcript.speaker: Maya
transcript.text: Bold call. Tom, thanks so much for coming on Media Mix.
